# Microsoft 2026 Environmental Data Fact Sheet (FY25)

## Key Findings (recovered via Exa PDF fetch + secondary sources)

### GHG Emissions (mtCO2e)
| Scope | FY20 | FY21 | FY22 | FY23 | FY24 | FY25 |
|-------|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| Scope 1 | 118,100 | 123,704 | 139,413 | 144,960 | 143,510 | 170,887 |
| Scope 2 (location) | 4,328,916 | 5,010,667 | 6,381,250 | 8,077,403 | 9,955,368 | 12,030,556 |
| Scope 2 (market) | 456,119 | 429,405 | 288,029 | 393,134 | 259,090 | 2,707,428 |
| Subtotal (1+2 market) | 574,219 | 553,109 | 427,442 | 538,094 | 402,600 | 2,878,315 |
| Scope 3 Cat 1 | 4,587,000 | 5,265,000 | 5,417,000 | 5,648,000 | 5,606,000 | 5,129,000 |
| Scope 3 Cat 2 | 4,334,000 | 4,085,000 | 4,785,000 | 5,990,000 | 6,291,000 | 9,044,000 |

- Total emissions (Scopes 1+2+3) increased 25% year over year in FY25.
- Headline total under management criteria: 20.29 million tonnes CO2e (up 25% from 16.22M in FY24).
- GHG Protocol total: 21.12 million tonnes.
- Scope 3: 17.41 million tonnes (~86% of management-criteria footprint).
- Capital goods (Scope 3 Cat 2): 9.04 million tonnes (largest category).
- Scope 2 market-based jumped to 2.71M tonnes from 0.27M (Feb 2025 decision to stop buying spot EACs).
- Scope 2 now 13% of total emissions (up from ~2% prior year).

### Water (ML)
| Metric | FY20 | FY21 | FY22 | FY23 | FY24 | FY25 |
|--------|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| Total withdrawals | 6,794 | 7,747 | 8,698 | 9,666 | 11,590 | 13,266 |
| Total discharges | 2,804 | 2,953 | 3,369 | 3,848 | 4,897 | 5,096 |
| Total consumption | 3,990 | 4,794 | 5,329 | 5,818 | 6,693 | 8,170 |

- FY25: Replenished >14.2 million m³ of water (first time exceeding global withdrawals).
- FY25 global average WUE: 0.27 L/kWh; 25% reduction since 2022 baseline (target: 40% by 2030).
- Phoenix AZ datacenters improved WUE by 23% YoY in FY25.
- Funded 24 new water replenishment projects (>29M m³ lifetime benefit).
- Contracted projects represent >133M m³ replenishment volume (53,200 Olympic pools), 34 priority locations.

### Energy
- 100% annual electricity matched with renewable energy (procurement measure, not round-the-clock).
- Carbon removal contracted in FY25: >45 million tonnes (delivery over up to 3 decades).

### Waste
- 92% reuse and recycling of operational waste.
- 90% of construction and demolition waste diverted from landfill/incinerators.
- Expanded Circular Centers to 7 facilities globally.
